tools.description:
Calculate RSI/SMA/EMA and RSI thresholds or moving-average crossovers from
        completed ChartServer candles. Use this for technical analysis instead of model
        arithmetic or get_latest_quote; get_historical_bars is for raw OHLC.
        Supply exact API contract codes and period codes (1=M1, 2=H1, 6=M5, 7=M15).
        Each series permits count+offset <=1000, up to 6 indicators and 50 output points;
        offset skips newest completed bars and is a moving-window page, not a stable cursor.
        Check per-series issues, missing warm-up, input range and freshness. LIMITED data
        supports historical values only; null conditions are not a neutral signal. Current
        conditions never authorize trading or establish that the market is open.
        Individual history failures are returned per series. No orders or quote stream.
tools.name: analyze_indicators

convention.default: Close prices; SMA arithmetic mean; EMA alpha=2/(n+1), SMA seed; RSI Wilder smoothing with n-change arithmetic seed (n+1 closes), zero average loss yields 100 including flat input. Each window seeds independently.
convention.title: Convention

tools.description:
Preview and cancel a working order by order_ref.

        Start with action=preview, the order reference and a cancellation comment.
        Use action=submit with the returned local intent_id to open the human
        form. HTTP 200 confirms cancellation even with an empty body. If the
        result is UNKNOWN, check the same intent_id with get_execution_status.
        It checks the original order reference and can confirm the cancelled
        state without identifying the actor.
tools.name: cancel_pending_order

reason.default: Requested protection has not been verified from position detail.
reason.title: Reason

tools.description:
Preview and close all or part of one open position.

        With action=preview, supply the exact position_ref and amount to close
        in contract units. Use the full reported amount to close the position.
        Review the original position, requested reduction, expected remaining
        amount and server price source. Pass the preview's client_order_id with
        action=submit to open the human form. Use that ID for UNKNOWN status.
tools.name: close_position

reason.default: Requested protection has not been verified from position detail.
reason.title: Reason

tools.description:
Preview or apply changes to an existing working order.

        With action=preview, supply the order_ref and at least one field to change.
        Amount is in contract units and prices are absolute. Omitted fields are
        preserved. The preview shows the prior order and changes as REST field
        names. Use action=submit with the new client_order_id returned by the
        preview to open the human form for those saved changes. For UNKNOWN,
        query get_execution_status with that edit ID and keep the original journal.
tools.name: edit_pending_order

reason.default: Requested protection has not been verified from position detail.
reason.title: Reason

tools.description:
Use for a proposed Forex trade's loss-at-stop or absolute risk-budget size.

        Supply an exact API contract, BUY/SELL, absolute stop_loss and amount,
        or risk_budget with its explicit currency (or both). Uses a fresh quote
        as hypothetical entry: ask for BUY, bid for SELL. Only category=0 linear
        Forex in its reported counter currency is supported; other products and
        currency conversions are unavailable. Never substitute model arithmetic.
        Sizing needs positive reported lot/account caps and complete quantities;
        missing caps are not unlimited. Check each calculation's status, inputs,
        source times and limitations. This is not existing-position P/L, maximum
        guaranteed loss, margin affordability or trading permission. It creates
        no intent, approval or order. Use get_risk_summary for account exposure;
        any subsequent trade still needs its own prepare/approval/execute flow.
tools.name: estimate_trade_risk

tools.description:
Use only after explicit approval of a prepared order cancellation.

        The MCP host must pass the returned confirmation token and approved=true,
        then a person must accept the server's separate exact-intent MCP form.
        A model argument or Always Allow setting is not approval.
        This calls cancelOrder once. HTTP 200 confirms cancellation even with
        an empty body. On an ambiguous response, the tool checks the original
        order reference and returns UNKNOWN if cancellation remains unconfirmed.
tools.name: execute_cancel_order

reason.default: Requested protection has not been verified from position detail.
reason.title: Reason

tools.description:
Use only after explicit approval of a prepared order edit.

        The MCP host must pass the returned confirmation token and approved=true,
        then a person must accept the server's separate exact-intent MCP form.
        A model argument or Always Allow setting is not approval.
        This calls editOrder once with a stable client order ID. Without a
        reliable reference, only a matching mutation client ID and original order
        terms can confirm the read-back; otherwise return UNKNOWN. After an ambiguous
        API error, use get_execution_status to reconcile without resubmitting.
        Do not retry with a new client order ID.
tools.name: execute_edit_order

reason.default: Requested protection has not been verified from position detail.
reason.title: Reason

tools.description:
Use only after explicit user approval of a prepared liquidation.

        Pass approved=true and the token returned by prepare_liquidation to open
        a separate human MCP form. Only accepting the exact saved terms before
        expiry authorizes execution; the flag alone cannot. A missing
        liquidation reference is not failure. Confirmation needs the original
        execution correlation and the exact remaining position in detail and
        account state. Position disappearance or a similar reduction alone
        cannot prove this operation executed. UNKNOWN is status-only: call
        get_execution_status with the original intent; never submit a replacement.
tools.name: execute_liquidation

reason.default: Requested protection has not been verified from position detail.
reason.title: Reason

tools.description:
Use only after explicit user approval of a prepared market order.

        Pass the token returned by prepare_market_order and approved=true to request
        a human-operated MCP form showing the saved terms. That flag is not approval;
        the human must accept the form before the original intent expires. The server enforces
        explicit trading opt-in, local account binding, request integrity, and confirmation.
        Account type is unverified; independently confirm the intended account.
        A missing deal reference is
        reconciled against account state; never retry with a new client order ID
        when the result is UNKNOWN.
        Protected entry remains UNKNOWN until position identity and protection
        read-back verify requested SL/TP and expiry policies, even with a dealRef.
        Attached protection is checked through linked working order detail.
        Inspect protection
        and next_safe_action: MISMATCH needs manual review, never resubmission or
        an automatic protection repair. EXECUTED does not guarantee future SL fills.
tools.name: execute_market_order

reason.default: Requested protection has not been verified from position detail.
reason.title: Reason

tools.description:
Use only after explicit approval of a prepared pending order's complete terms.

        Requires the unchanged account configuration, matching confirmation token,
        approved=true, a separate accepted human MCP form, and trading enabled.
        The flag alone is not consent. Calls addOrder once with a stable
        client order ID. EXECUTED confirms order submission, not a filled position.
        Use get_working_orders or get_order_detail for current order lifecycle state.
        A 202 response or missing reliable orderNo is UNKNOWN; get_execution_status
        checks the same client ID without another write. No ID in the read-back or
        conflicting records cannot confirm submission. Never submit a replacement
        for UNKNOWN. Use prepare_edit_order or prepare_cancel_order once the order
        reference is confirmed, and approve those operations separately.
tools.name: execute_pending_order

reason.default: Requested protection has not been verified from position detail.
reason.title: Reason

tools.description:
Use only after explicit approval of a prepared position SL/TP pair.

        Requires approved=true, the returned confirmation token, acceptance of a
        separate human MCP form showing prior_position and the full pair, trading enabled
        and unchanged account/intent binding. Rechecks position identity, remaining
        amount, prior protection and a fresh quote before editDealOcoPair dispatch.
        A closed or concurrently changed position blocks submission. Uses one
        stable client ID; 200 or returned protection refs alone do not confirm
        success. EXECUTED requires linked working orders on this exact position,
        approved prices and expiry policies, plus returned refs or matching client
        IDs. UNKNOWN means check the same get_execution_status intent, never
        repeat the mutation or automatically repair protection. MISMATCH requires
        manual review. Verified read-back is an observation, not a future fill
        guarantee or an atomic server-side compare-and-set.
tools.name: execute_position_protection

reason.default: Requested protection has not been verified from position detail.
reason.title: Reason

tools.description: Get current balance, equity and margin values reported by FxServer.
tools.name: get_account_balance

Get display and settlement currencies and the reported conversion settings.

tools.name: get_account_currencies

tools.description:
Use for a bounded current account review, including after manual terminal changes.

        Fresh independent GETs return reported balance/margin metrics, positions and
        working/executed/cancelled order collections, at most limit records each.
        Check every source time, collection status and omission/invalid counts.
        COMPLETE empty arrays differ from PARTIAL/UNAVAILABLE, which are not empty
        account evidence. Reads are non-atomic; monetary currency remains UNKNOWN.
        No quote subscription, history, preparation or mutation. Events only suggest
        refreshing; this tool is not execution reconciliation or proof of a fill.
        Use get_risk_summary for grouped exposure, review_activity for dated history.
tools.name: get_account_review

reason.default: Collection unavailable or malformed; not evidence of an empty account.
reason.title: Reason

tools.description:
Use when the user needs one current view of balance, open positions, and orders.

        This single response includes balance, open positions, and working,
        executed, and cancelled order groups; prefer it for a combined account
        raw-data question instead of separate current-state tools. For a bounded
        account review with per-source failures, use get_account_review. Do not
        use it for historical data or a live quote. This is read-only and does
        not change the account. Use get_contract_settings and get_latest_quote
        before preparing a trade. If the response is ambiguous, report the API
        error and do not infer an account state.
tools.name: get_account_snapshot

tools.description: List reported cash movements and their statuses for up to 31 report days.

tools.name: get_chart_live_statistics

tools.name: get_chart_open_price

tools.description: Get settings for one exact account contract code.
tools.name: get_contract_setting

tools.description:
Use before trading to validate contract availability, lot rules,
        amount limits, and tradability for the current account. Do not use it as
        a price source or to submit a trade. It is read-only; normally follow it
        with get_latest_quote or a preparation tool. Treat an unavailable
        response as a validation failure.
tools.name: get_contract_settings

tools.description:
Use for completed liquidation/deal history over a date range.

        Do not use it to inspect current open positions or to submit a close.
        This is read-only; use get_open_positions for current state and
        prepare_liquidation for a known open position. A missing or ambiguous
        response must not be treated as proof that no deals exist. This raw
        compatibility read has no coverage metadata; prefer review_activity for
        bounded summaries and source limitations.
tools.name: get_deal_history

tools.description:
Use after a delayed or ambiguous execution to inspect the MCP
        operation state. Pass client_order_id for the shared local journal
        lookup or intent_id for a legacy workflow. Supply exactly one ID.
        This does not submit a new request and may reconcile
        the same client order ID after a process restart. If it remains UNKNOWN,
        do not create a new intent or retry with a new client order ID.
        Each call makes at most three read-back attempts, with a ten-second
        timeout per attempt and one second between attempts. Use
        confirmation_evidence, last_checked_at_ms, and last_check_error to
        distinguish confirmation from a failed check. Follow next_safe_action:
        CHECK_EXECUTION_STATUS means check the same intent again later;
        retry_after_seconds is advisory, not automatic polling. MANUAL_REVIEW
        means resolve the read/access problem and inspect account state first.
        An unbound legacy intent or changed account configuration requires
        MANUAL_REVIEW without backend reads. Keep the original journal and configuration.
        A null result means no execution result is recorded in this journal.
        An intent may exist from preparation alone. Inspect the original
        intent and account state manually rather than assuming execution failed.
tools.name: get_execution_status

reason.default: Requested protection has not been verified from position detail.
reason.title: Reason

tools.description:
Use for chart or strategy analysis requiring completed historical bars.
        Do not use this as a replacement for the live quote tool or as execution
        confirmation. This is read-only; normally follow it with a separate
        quote or preparation request. Returns bars plus freshness and
        irregular_intervals. Do not calculate a current signal when freshness
        is STALE, UNKNOWN, or UNAVAILABLE. Check interval breaks before analysis;
        session closures can cause breaks, so do not assume they prove feed loss.
tools.name: get_historical_bars

tools.description: Get the last reported consecutive trade count and P&L, if recorded.
tools.name: get_last_trade_streak

tools.description: Get the latest cached OHLC bar. It may still be forming.
tools.name: get_latest_chart_bar

tools.description:
Use when the user needs the current account-specific bid and ask for a
        contract. Do not use it for completed candles or as proof that a trade
        executed. This uses the live Price Agent stream and is read-only; normally
        follow it with a preparation tool only when freshness.status is FRESH.
        STALE or UNKNOWN prices must not inform a new trade. The timestamp is
        local per-contract receive time, not the broker's quote creation time.
        A recent quote does not prove that the market is open.
tools.name: get_latest_quote

tools.description: Get the broker's closure detail using a liquidation reference.
tools.name: get_liquidation_detail

tools.description:
Use when the user asks whether a market is open or its data is fresh.

        Read-only: checks quote, completed bars, and weekly trading hours.
        market_state stays UNKNOWN because the API schedule has no timezone
        or holiday calendar. Never equate fresh data with an open market or
        stale/unavailable data with a closed one. Report each source's status
        and timestamp separately; this is not an atomic snapshot. If the user
        wants a trade, use get_contract_settings and the approval workflow next.
        This tool does not place trades or prove execution; use
        get_execution_status for execution reconciliation.
tools.name: get_market_status

market_state_reason.default: The weekly schedule has no timezone or holiday calendar; data availability does not prove that the market is open or closed.
market_state_reason.title: Market State Reason

tools.description:
Use to inspect current open positions. Do not use it for order history
        or historical chart data. It is read-only; use prepare_liquidation for a
        known position. Do not infer that a position is closed from an event
        notification alone; refresh this tool after an ambiguous result.
tools.name: get_open_positions

tools.description:
Use for one order's detail by reference.

        Pass order_type 1 for working, 2 for executed, or 3 for cancelled.
        Do not use it to edit or cancel an order. This is read-only; use the
        matching preparation tool for a mutation. A null result is only a
        point-in-time lookup result and must not prove a previous mutation failed.
tools.name: get_order_detail

tools.description:
Use for executed-order history over a date range.

        Do not use it for current working orders or current positions; use
        get_working_orders or get_open_positions for those. This is read-only
        and does not change the account. Use the returned order references with
        get_order_detail or get_position_detail when more detail is needed.
        An unavailable or malformed history response is an error, not an empty
        trading history. This raw compatibility read has no coverage metadata;
        prefer review_activity for bounded summaries and source limitations.
tools.name: get_order_history

tools.description:
Use when a known position reference needs its detailed state.

        Do not use it as a general position list or as execution confirmation
        after a timeout without checking the account state again. This is
        read-only; normally use get_open_positions first to obtain a reference.
        A null result means the reference was not found at that read time.
tools.name: get_position_detail

tools.description: List open positions as reported for an end date. Use get_open_positions for now.
tools.name: get_report_open_positions

tools.description:
Use for account risk, exposure, margin context or a grouped portfolio overview.

        Read-only: groups BUY/SELL, gross and signed net contract-unit amounts
        per contract, separately for open positions and working orders. Reports
        available equity, freeMargin and decimal marginRatio (2.2 = 220%).
        SL context distinguishes reported prices from unreported protection;
        absent summary fields do not prove there is no SL. Read position detail
        and linked orders to resolve unreported levels.
        UNKNOWN is not zero or proof of low risk; monetary currency basis and
        server freshness may be unknown. Never sum amounts across contracts,
        assume orders filled, or infer affordability, loss-at-stop or permission
        to trade. Reads are non-atomic; check each source's local read time.
        Use get_account_snapshot for raw account data, get_latest_quote for a
        price, and the separate prepare/approval/execute tools for any trade.
        This tool does not change approval policy or reconcile an execution.
tools.name: get_risk_summary

reason.default: A missing/sentinel SL field is unreported, not proof of no protection. Read position detail and linked working orders before concluding a stop is absent. A reported price alone does not verify an active broker stop.
reason.title: Reason

tools.description: Get the broker's statement totals for up to 31 report days.
tools.name: get_statement_summary

tools.description: List closures for the broker's current trading day.
tools.name: get_today_liquidations

tools.description:
Use before preparing a trade when the user needs a contract's weekly
        trading schedule. This is read-only and returns the WebProxy schedule;
        weekday uses 1=Sunday, 2=Monday, through 7=Saturday.
        it does not prove that the market is open now because timezone, holidays,
        and exceptional sessions may be outside this response. Still use the
        trading API response as authoritative, and use get_latest_quote for the
        current account-specific price.
tools.name: get_trading_hours

tools.description:
Use to inspect working, executed, and cancelled orders. Do not use it
        to submit, edit, or cancel an order. It is read-only; use it after an
        ambiguous order response before any further action, and never infer that
        a missing record proves a mutation failed.
tools.name: get_working_orders

tools.description:
Use when the user wants to SEE a candle chart, not just OHLC data.

        Creates a loopback browser-viewer link using validated completed ChartServer
        history. Open or show the returned URL on the SAME computer as this MCP
        process; a remote host's localhost URL is not trader-visible delivery.
        This does not launch a browser or embed a native host chart automatically.
        The viewer supports exact API contract codes, period selection and explicit
        refresh. It is a historical snapshot, not a live price stream or control of
        the mF terminal. STALE history is labelled; invalid/unavailable history is
        not plotted. No trades, drawings or indicators are changed. Use
        get_historical_bars for raw data, analyze_indicators for calculations and
        get_latest_quote for an account-specific bid/ask. The link lasts only while
        this MCP process runs; restarting it invalidates the old viewer link.
tools.name: open_candle_chart

tools.description:
Use when the user asks to cancel an existing working order.

        This creates a local approval intent only and does not call cancelOrder.
        Show the complete prior_order, order reference and comment, then execute only
        after explicit approval. The API may return HTTP 200 without a response
        body, so execution verifies the original order's identity and terms in
        cancelled state, with no conflicting working or executed record. Disappearance
        alone is not confirmation. Changed terms or a fill before dispatch stop the write.
tools.name: prepare_cancel_order

tools.description:
Use when the user asks to modify an existing pending order.

        Provide at least one editable field. This creates a local approval
        intent only and does not call editOrder. Show the order reference and
        every requested change and complete prior_order, then call execute_edit_order
        only after explicit user approval. Preparation reads the original working
        order and validates effective entry, amount and protection against account
        rules and a fresh quote. Manual changes or a fill invalidate approval.
        A matching receipt or mutation client ID plus complete read-back is required;
        matching requested fields alone cannot confirm an empty/202 response.
        Use get_execution_status on UNKNOWN; never submit a replacement automatically.
tools.name: prepare_edit_order

tools.description:
Use when the user wants to close an existing position.

        Do not use it without a known open position reference. This only creates
        a local intent and does not modify the account. Confirm the position
        reference and amount in contract units before execution. The saved
        position_reduction shows prior amount, requested close and expected
        remainder (zero for full close). Review these exact terms with the user.
        If position lookup or amount rules are unavailable, do not guess them;
        call get_open_positions and get_contract_settings first.
tools.name: prepare_liquidation

tools.description:
Use when the user asks to buy or sell and a current quote, contract
        validation, and approval summary must be prepared first.

        Do not use this tool to execute an order or to close a position. It only
        creates a local intent and does not change the account. Call
        execute_market_order only after the user explicitly approves the
        returned account, contract, side, amount, all SL/TP prices and good-till
        policies, quote source, and approval expiry. Optional protective prices
        are positive absolute prices; policies are 0=Friday, 1=Cancel (default
        when a price is provided), 2=Day End. A policy requires its price.
        Protection is submitted atomically with market entry in priceMode=1;
        price and priceTag are omitted and the server chooses the fill price.
        Preparation uses a fresh quote and does not guarantee the fill price.
        If validation or quote retrieval is ambiguous, do not execute the intent.
tools.name: prepare_market_order

tools.description:
Use to prepare a new opening limit or stop order at a specified future entry price.

        Use prepare_market_order for immediate entry and prepare_edit_order to
        modify an existing order. Stop-limit and closing pending orders are not
        supported by this tool. amount is contract units, not lots; validate with
        get_contract_settings and a fresh get_latest_quote. Buy limits are below
        ask and buy stops above ask; sell limits are above bid and sell stops below bid.
        good_till uses the backend codes: 0=Friday, 1=Cancel, 2=Day End.
        TP/SL must be on the appropriate side of the entry price; their good-till
        defaults to the entry's good_till when a protective price is provided.
        This only creates a local intent. Show all terms, account binding and
        approval expiry; call execute_pending_order only after explicit approval.
        The approval TTL limits submission, not the working order's lifetime.
tools.name: prepare_pending_order

tools.description:
Prepare setting or changing BOTH SL/TP levels on an existing open position.

        Use get_open_positions to identify the exact position reference first.
        This does not trade. Both positive absolute prices are required; expiry
        policies are 0=Friday, 1=Cancel (explicit adapter default), 2=Day End.
        The tool does not support removal or omitted partner fields because the
        published REST contract does not define those semantics. Do not substitute
        zero, null or -1, cancel linked orders, or use pending-order edit to remove
        protection. To preserve a level, explicitly supply its verified existing
        price and policy alongside the changed level, and review the whole pair.
        Show the account binding, position, full remaining amount, prior_position,
        every new price/policy, quote source and approval expiry. Null prior terms
        mean UNREPORTED, not absent. Obtain explicit approval of this exact pair
        before calling execute_position_protection. This changes server-side
        position protection, not chart markers, position size or pending entry price.
tools.name: prepare_position_protection

tools.description:
Use for a bounded executed-order and liquidation activity review over explicit dates.

        Supply YYYY-MM-DD begin/end dates (1-31 inclusive days), currency settle/display,
        and limit 1-100 records per source. Dates use the backend's report semantics;
        timezone/boundary inclusion is unreported. No backend pagination is documented;
        never invent pages or claim full range coverage, including on empty results.
        Exact projected duplicates are removed. Inspect failures, truncation and source
        times. Report per-record PL/fees as supplied; do not sum cross-source commissions,
        per-lot storage, or invent total P&L, fees, net returns or currency conversions.
        No quote subscription or account changes. Use get_account_review for current
        positions/orders and get_execution_status for the original ambiguous intent.

end_date.description: Report end date, YYYY-MM-DD; at most 31 inclusive days.
end_date.title: End Date

tools.name: review_activity

end_date.description: Report end date, YYYY-MM-DD; at most 31 inclusive days.
end_date.title: End Date

reason.default: Collection unavailable or malformed; not evidence of an empty account.
reason.title: Reason

tools.description:
Preview and set a complete take-profit and stop-loss pair on a position.

        With action=preview, supply position_ref and both positive absolute prices.
        Good-till codes are 0=Friday, 1=Cancel and 2=Day End. To keep one leg,
        supply its existing terms as part of the full pair. This tool cannot
        remove a leg. Pass the new client_order_id with action=submit to open the
        human form. Use that ID to check an UNKNOWN result.
tools.name: set_position_protection

reason.default: Requested protection has not been verified from position detail.
reason.title: Reason

tools.description:
Compatibility alias for market entry. Use submit_order for new workflows.

        To use this alias, start with action=preview,
        contract, side and amount in contract units. Optional SL/TP are absolute
        prices; their good-till values are 0=Friday, 1=Cancel, 2=Day End.
        A preview does not write to the account. On the user's request, call
        action=submit with the returned client_order_id to open the human review
        form. The server submits the saved terms only after the person accepts.
        Use get_execution_status with the same client_order_id for UNKNOWN.
        Do not use this tool to close a position or retry an uncertain submission.
tools.name: submit_market_order

reason.default: Requested protection has not been verified from position detail.
reason.title: Reason

tools.title: Market order (compatibility)

tools.description:
Preferred tool to preview and submit an opening MARKET, LIMIT or STOP order.

        Start with action=preview and give the exact contract, side, amount in
        contract units and order_type. LIMIT and STOP require an entry price.
        MARKET uses the server's execution price. Review the returned terms and
        use action=submit with the preview's client_order_id to open the human
        form. After approval the order is sent once. EXECUTED for a pending
        order confirms submission, not a fill. For UNKNOWN, look up the original
        client_order_id with get_execution_status.
tools.name: submit_order

reason.default: Requested protection has not been verified from position detail.
reason.title: Reason

tools.description:
Compatibility alias for opening LIMIT or STOP orders. Use submit_order for new workflows.

        With action=preview, supply contract, side, amount in contract units,
        order_type and price. The preview shows expiry and any attached SL/TP.
        Good-till codes are 0=Friday, 1=Cancel and 2=Day End. Use action=submit
        with the returned client_order_id to open the human approval form for
        those saved terms. EXECUTED confirms submission of the pending order.
        Check get_order_detail for fills. For UNKNOWN, use get_execution_status
        with the original client_order_id. Use edit_pending_order to change a
        working order and the cancellation workflow to cancel it.
tools.name: submit_pending_order

reason.default: Requested protection has not been verified from position detail.
reason.title: Reason

tools.title: Pending order (compatibility)

tools.description:
Wait for one PositionUpdate SSE notification for up to 15 seconds.

        On an event, reread account or position data. A timeout does not establish
        stream health or account state. Use get_execution_status to reconcile writes.
tools.name: wait_for_position_update
